purpose: Validate future experiment inputs, boundaries, and preservation behavior before a separately authorized execution lane exists.
required_invariants: No identity plane may supply another plane's fields.
A packet selection names one exact file, one digest, one external manifest, and matching requested, subject, current, and reachable source heads for a current experiment.
Nested input discovery uses one exact stage root and one exact inventory; broad glob selection and unexpected candidates fail closed.
An adapter identity includes its exact folder, config, model bytes, base model revision, PEFT type, and target modules.
Transport metadata keeps secret values out of records, makes fallback policy explicit, and keeps cache roots outside source.

QLoRA requires an explicit four-bit setting, an available bitsandbytes CUDA backend, four-bit modules, compatible runtime libraries, process isolation, lifecycle cleanup, telemetry, and an admitted envelope.
The output root must be external to the source tree and separates ephemeral heavy, model cache, adapter cache, run scratch, durable heavy, and assessment return zones.
Supervision, measurement, scorecard, and claim records preserve provenance, scorer-only expected-answer handling, arithmetic reconciliation, and evidence-tier ceilings.
A failed simulated arm preserves completed measured rows as assessment-only evidence without a performance claim.
out_of_scope: Kaggle notebook or one-cell runner execution
